results.name: EATEN: stock consumed (qty), supplement applied + rotation advanced, result stored
REFUSED: counts as refusal, supplement NOT consumed/advanced, no stock
IN SHED: no stock, no supplement, rotation not advanced, last success unchanged, not a refusal
NOT FED: no stock, not a refusal; planned feeding of that day resolved
Duplicate protection: same animal + same feeding family + same day asks instead of duplicating
APPETITE: consecutive refusals alert; in-shed never counts nor breaks streak
SHED: insufficient data → window from individual intervals → observed
GROUP: representative + 4 members; group feeding 3 eaten / 1 refused in one batch
GROUP: individual history per member; group batch is all-or-nothing (rollback)
HISTORY: grouped by human day with batch summary (DNES / VČERA / date)
CORRECTION days later (group member): performed_at kept, eaten→refused, audit columns + audit log
CORRECTION eaten(2× Dubia)→in shed restores stock +2 and rolls the supplement rotation back
SOFT DELETE → recycle bin → restore
SUPPLEMENT rotation over time: eaten advances, in-shed / not-fed / refused do not
Future-dated record refused (planner is for the future)
TAXONOMY: Latin-first autocomplete (prefix of genus, species epithet, Czech alias)
TAXONOMY: manual taxon without Czech name + aliases; invalid Latin rejected; reuse same Latin
ENCLOSURE clone ×3: dimensions/climate/rules copied, new identity, no animals, audit
ANIMAL archive → history kept, tasks paused, quota freed → restore exact status
HABITAT load: empty room (no demo), Manager enclosures present as mgr_inst_*
HABITAT save: new instance → Manager enclosure; assembly → Sestava; revision conflict detected
BILLING: webhook signature verified, duplicate ignored, order paid only after server re-fetch
ENTITLEMENT: admin_manual grant PRO with expiry; FREE quota blocks the 11th animal but never locks existing data
EXPORT JSON+ZIP, integrity report, backup + retention
LIVE summary: real counts, appetite alert after 3 refusals
